p12_shared_host_2026_10_11.phase_cost_method: Elapsed wall time, not CPU attribution. gpu_instances_ms is part of pdh_decode_ms, excludes wildcard expansion, and must not be added to it. engine_mapping_ms is sampler event mapping; engine_snapshot_mapping_ms is caller snapshot mapping. engine_publication_ms is state publication and previous snapshot retirement under the mutex. Main lacks the three newly separated subphase fields.

short_profile.method: Temporary per-thread cycle instrumentation, 30 one-second all-channel ticks, excluding first three warmup ticks; removed before A/B. Cycles are diagnostic only, not an overhead percentage or a hardware-frequency claim.
